editions.title: August 5, 2026
editions.dek: Reporting is attributed and graded by certainty; anything that could not be stood up in a reliable source has been left out or labelled as unconfirmed.

editions.title: August 3, 2026
editions.dek: Outside Lands takes Golden Gate Park Friday through Sunday — already sold out at every GA tier — while Pistahan fills Yerba Buena, the Sonoma County Fair opens a ten-day run in Santa Rosa and San Jose Jazz Summer Fest puts a hundred artists on eight downtown stages.

editions.title: August 1, 2026
editions.dek: The Polo Field disappears under Outside Lands (Aug 7–9, and yes, it is sold out), but the better story this month is free: the 89th Stern Grove Festival closes its season with four consecutive heavyweights — Violent Femmes, Patti LaBelle, Public Enemy and, on Aug 16, Al Green .

editions.title: August 1, 2026
editions.dek: The single biggest piece of Arsenal business this summer moved between 8pm and midnight UK time last night, and it is still moving as you read this.

editions.title: July 31, 2026
editions.dek: He gave one club twenty seasons, invented a way of defending that the modern game has quietly abandoned, and carried the most famous missed penalty in Italian football without ever once hiding from it.

editions.title: July 30, 2026
editions.dek: Arsenal is covered in its own companion edition and is carved out here except where standings or an opponent make a mention unavoidable.

editions.title: July 29, 2026
editions.dek: It took Spain 116 years of football and a fourteenth year of trying since their first world title to arrive here, and when it finally came it came the way Spain have always insisted the game should be won: with the ball, patiently, until the opposition's resistance simply wore through.

editions.title: July 29, 2026
editions.dek: But the title defence opens under a cloud: William Saliba is expected to miss four to five months with the back injury he carried home from the World Cup, and Jurrien Timber is in a race to be fit for kickoff.

editions.title: July 27, 2026
editions.dek: After a gray-edged start to the week (highs 65–67°F), Friday clears to ~69°F and Saturday Aug 1 should touch 72°F in the city — genuinely warm for an SF August — with Sunday near 69°F, lows ~57°F, and zero rain chances across the whole stretch.

editions.title: July 25, 2026
editions.dek: Beneath the confetti, the biggest tournament ever staged doubled as a farewell for the game’s old kings — and a shop window that will define the summer’s transfer market.

editions.title: July 25, 2026
editions.dek: The Lead Arteta Rolls the Dice for Bruno — and Redraws the Champions’ Summer With the Premier League trophy in the cabinet for the first time in twenty-two years, Arsenal are chasing the one profile they still lack: a ball-carrying, tone-setting midfield general.

editions.title: July 20, 2026
editions.dek: Then the weekend of August 6–9 goes fully feral: Outside Lands, San Jose Jazz Summer Fest, Pistahan, the Gravenstein Apple Fair, two county fairs (Sonoma and Napa, newly confirmed for Aug 6–9), and a Giants–Tigers homestand, all at once.

editions.title: July 18, 2026
editions.dek: Tonight, if you're free: the Hayes Valley Carnival runs into the evening, the Glen Park Night Market goes 3–8pm, and the expansion-darling Valkyries tip off at Chase Center at 5:30pm.

editions.title: July 16, 2026
editions.dek: Messi's Argentina Meet Spain's Machine Sunday in New Jersey, the tournament's most relentless attack collides with its most impenetrable defence — and a 39-year-old chases immortality against the teenager tipped to succeed him.
